svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: DPEG — Application ERD with Key Fields
Acquisition · Transaction · Property Management · Disposition — the full asset lifecycle, from a broker's inbound email to the sale proceeds wire.

Each object lists its relationship fields, then its defining business fields, then a "+N more" counter. Field names only — types omitted. 42 objects · 54 relationships · 738 custom fields in total · verified 2026-08-05
one A → many B · Lookup — B holds the lookup field to A
Master-Detail — B is owned by A and cascade-deletes with it
Not a lookup — lead conversion, or a plain Text pointer
Lead conversion — the spine of the acquisition lifecycle

Master-Detail exists in Property Management ONLY — 5 of 54 relationships (Unit__c, Rent_Step__c, Lease_Activity__c, Renewal_Activity__c, Work_Order_Activity__c). Every Acquisition, Transaction and Disposition relationship is a Lookup,
so deleting a deal or a Disposition orphans its children rather than removing them.

Column = dependency rank, parent always to the left; dashed band = module grouping within a rank. Fields shown are a curated subset — every box states how many it omits. Not drawn as edges: role lookups to User
(listed inside each box as ↗ rows), Opportunity's four reverse "primary" pointers (Primary_LOI__c / _Underwriting__c / _Contract__c / _NDA__c) and its self-lookup Portfolio_Deal__c.
